attestations.text: Shih Wang 十王, was the fifteenth son of Nurhaci [q. v.] and commander of the Bordered White Banner. He was the youngest of three sons born to Empress Hsiao-lieh [q. v.], his elder brothers being Ajige and Dorgon [qq. v.].
